# sample published pool text for make_study tests (mirrors canon/pool-general.txt layout: en-dash headings)
SUBELEMENT G1 – COMMISSION'S RULES [2 Exam Questions – 2 Groups]
G1A – General class control operator frequency privileges; primary and secondary allocations
G1A01 (C) [97.301(d)]
On which HF and/or MF amateur bands are there portions where General class licensees cannot transmit?
A. 60 meters, 30 meters, 17 meters, and 12 meters
B. 160 meters, 60 meters, 15 meters, and 12 meters
C. 80 meters, 40 meters, 20 meters, and 15 meters
D. 80 meters, 20 meters, 15 meters, and 10 meters
~~
G1A02 (B) [97.305]
On which of the following bands is phone operation prohibited?
A. 160 meters
B. 30 meters
C. 17 meters
D. 12 meters
~~
G1B – Antenna structure limitations; Beacon operations; Prohibited transmissions
G1B01 (C) [97.15(d)]
What is the maximum height above ground for an antenna structure without notification?
A. 50 feet
B. 100 feet
C. 200 feet
D. 300 feet
~~
SUBELEMENT G2 – OPERATING PROCEDURES [1 Exam Question – 1 Group]
G2A – Phone operating procedures; USB/LSB conventions
G2A01 (A)
Which sideband is most commonly used for voice operation on frequencies of 14 MHz or higher?
A. Upper sideband
B. Lower sideband
C. Vestigial sideband
D. Double sideband
~~
SUBELEMENT G5 – ELECTRICAL PRINCIPLES [1 Exam Question – 1 Group]
G5A – Reactance, inductance, capacitance, impedance, resonance
G5A01 (A)
What is impedance?
A. The opposition to AC current flow
B. The inverse of resistance
C. The power stored in an inductor
D. The charge stored in a capacitor
~~
SUBELEMENT G7 – PRACTICAL CIRCUITS [1 Exam Question – 1 group]
G7A – Power supplies and schematic symbols
G7A09 (A)
What is the purpose of C1 in the circuit shown in Figure G7-1?
A. It resonates with L1
B. It removes RF from the supply rail
C. It couples the output
D. It sets the bias
~~
